description: Schema-v1 index files (2026-07-23..2026-08-31) stored their strike axis once, in the header. A restart that rebuilt the chain around a different spot appended frames whose columns belong to a different strike window than the header names. These ranges are those frames, plus frames with no option prices. The archive files are NOT modified; readers treat these frames as missing.
method: Per process generation (frame sequence resets), each column's strike was implied by put-call parity (spot - (call - put)) * e^(rT) and compared with the header strike. Trusted: the first generation when its width matches the header and its parity is within 1.0 step; a later generation when its width matches and its parity agrees with the first within 0.5 step (spread < 1.5). Everything else is listed.
